newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euro Disney finance director leaves.
newsitem.headline: Euro Disney finance director leaves.

text.p: Euro Disney SCA said on Wednesday that president Gilles Pelisson would temporarily oversee the financial direction of the theme park operator following the departure of finance director Xavier de Mezerac.
It said in a statement that Mezerac had decided to explore career opportunities outside the company, which operates the Disneyland Paris resort.

Euro Disney announced several management appointments. Christian Perdrier, director of the hotels, assumes operational responsibility for the entire resort and becomes senior vice president-operations.
Theme park director Jeffrey Archambault is appointed director special projects and will oversee administrative systems, the use of information technology and purchasing policies.
Marc Robino is appointed director-restaurants. He was previously director of worldwide restaurants and purchasing for Novotel, part of the Accor group.
